column1: # The CROSS-SECTIONAL DRIFT DISPERSION ruler for `-basketdrift`: how much the names of a real
# basket differ in their own long-run drift, once the noise of a finite window is taken out.
# Measured on the basket ruler's eight names and window (`basket-2026-10-03.tsv`: SMH's eight
# largest holdings as of 2026-10-02, 2012-01-04..2026-08-31, T = 14.6 years), daily adjusted closes
# from Yahoo Finance's daily history, LOG returns.
# THE DECOMPOSITION.  A name's realized drift (mean daily log return x 252) over T years is its true
# drift plus estimation noise, and the noise has sd = (the name's idio vol) / sqrt(T) -- so a
# cross-section of realized drifts is dispersed even when every true drift is identical.
# `driftSpread` is the observed cross-sectional sd (n - 1); `noiseFloor` is the mean over names of
# the residual vol after SMH (OLS beta, annualized) over sqrt(T); `trueSpread` is
# sqrt(max(0, driftSpread^2 - noiseFloor^2)).
# THE RESULT, AND WHY THE DIAL SHIPS AT 0.  The decomposition reads 0.062 a year, and all of it is one
# name: INTC's +0.114 against the other seven's +0.262 to +0.447.  Without INTC the spread (0.065) is
# under its noise floor (0.071).  One name in a list selected today -- survivors, which truncates the
# left tail of realized drift -- does not calibrate a dial, so `-basketdrift` ships at 0 and is
# ungraded.  The true value needs point-in-time membership including the names that left the index,
# which these sources do not give.
# WHAT THIS DIAL DOES NOT FIX.  The names' time below peak is not a dispersion miss: it is the
# COMMON drift.  The eight realized +0.297/yr while the model's names carry the shared leg's
# +0.117 over the same 15-year horizon (`model commonDrift` below -- beta x the primary's own
# realized drift).  Dispersion around the right centre widens the SPREAD of time-below-peak across
# names -- which is what the dial is for, and what `nameD20Spread` reads -- and barely moves the
# level: at 200x100 on the S&P recipe the spread runs 0.14 -> 0.67 across the dial's range while
# the median goes 0.528 -> 0.557.  Raising the centre to the eight's +0.297 would be calibrating
# the model to names selected for having won, so it is not on offer.
# GAP SYMMETRY, and why it is here.  These rows also anchor the `-basketgaps` channel's SHAPE.  A
# name's OWN moves past 10% (residual after SMH) run 43 up to 37 down across the eight, mean
# +0.007 and mean magnitude 0.140 -- symmetric, or if anything tilted up.  The DOWN-skew belongs to
# the index (SMH itself: 1 up, 3 down; skew -0.28) and reaches every name through the shared leg.
# A name's own gap channel is therefore symmetric.
# `alphaSpread` / `alphaNoiseFloor` repeat the decomposition on the residual after regressing each
# name on the group index (SMH), which removes the part of the drift spread that is beta times the
# index's own drift: 0.079 against 0.072, again INTC's (without it 0.062 against 0.071).
